value.rationale: The source singles out dimension five as conjecturally reflection-rigid and explicitly leaves the N=6 dihedral system without an existence assertion. An exact radical solution is therefore a natural missing finite case, not an arbitrary parameter evaluation. It converts an uncertified numerical phenomenon into a reproducible theorem, gives a closed-form five-dimensional nonregular example, and exposes its full order-48 symmetry group. This supplies a concrete exact benchmark for Conjecture G5 and for the source's question about other nonregular dihedral branches.
